scope: Exploratory leave-one-original-training-recording-out study on already inspected data from one person/session. Original validation and test files are excluded. History has more parameters, so this does not isolate temporal order from capacity.
label_access: All models and train median fit identical eligible rows from the other eight recordings. Prefix median receives only eligible held-out references strictly before 10 seconds. Historic references do not determine input validity. Later labels cannot enter fitting or predictions.
